name: writer-loop-teardown-is-alive
title: writer_loop never tears down on dead write half; is_alive ignores writer_handle (half-open reuse + silent credit loss)
description: persistent.rs writer_loop warn-and-continues on write errors with no fatal classification; is_alive() consults only reader_handle, so a half-open connection is reused while FireForget inbound-credit OKAYs are silently dropped -> quiet flow-control deadlock. Add write-side fatal teardown + is_alive reflecting writer_handle. Coordinate with parent task #2 writer-loop teardown. Finding #5.
